# Data Source (postgresql_version)

Reads the PostgreSQL server version: the major and minor numbers, and the numeric server version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get PostgreSQL server version
data "postgresql_version" "current" {}

output "pg_version" {
  value = data.postgresql_version.current.version
}

output "pg_major" {
  value = data.postgresql_version.current.major
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `major` (Number) The major version number (e.g. 16).
- `minor` (Number) The minor version number (e.g. 2).
- `server_version_num` (Number) The numeric server version (e.g. 160002).
- `version` (String) The full version string returned by the server (e.g. PostgreSQL 16.2).
